query: Can I patent a classical Ayurvedic formulation that uses neem extract?

matched_chunks.text: Section 3(p) excludes from patentability an invention which, in effect, is traditional knowledge or which is an aggregation or duplication of known properties of traditionally known component or components.

A formulation shall be considered 'classical' where its composition, proportions, and method of preparation are drawn directly from a recognised Ayurvedic text without modification, and such formulations are treated as part of the traditional knowledge corpus for the purposes of patent examination.
matched_chunks.act_name: Ayurveda, Siddha and Unani Drugs Technical Advisory Board Guidelines

matched_chunks.text: Where an applicant modifies a traditional formulation through a novel extraction process, standardisation method, or a new therapeutic use not disclosed in prior art, the modified aspect alone may be examined for novelty and inventive step, independent of the underlying traditional formulation.
